about: The vocabulary in which every place socket is written (0103 decision 5). compile_settlement refuses a socket kind, activity, day phase, schedule purpose, item class, container class or fill rule that is not listed here. Each item class names the vanilla mesh folder or file that supplies its meshes. A socket therefore cannot promise an item that has no asset.
interactables_about: 2.4i: what a player does at a socket. Counted classes: sign (read), sleep (idle sleep), sit (idle sit), cook (idle cook, a work-at spot on a cooking host, a cooking-spit station), station (a station socket, or a work-at spot on a stationHosts host), shrine (a station socket of class shrine; pray). game-core interaction/interactables.ts holds these tables equal; worldgen.interactables gates every slice socket of these classes bound.
interactables_repairs_about: metal: weapons and armour of any set but softSets; soft: clothing and armour of softSets; none: the station reads as a sign of the trade
interactables_prayer_text: text.shrine.<socket id past socket.>: the words a prayer shows
service_surfaces_about: Decision 0113: a work socket (a station, or an idle socket whose activity is work-at) hosted on one of these is served across the host (its interact point is kind customer); any other work socket is used where the worker stands (kind station). Matched on the host asset's file name, as furnitureActivities is.
